connector.name: Indonesia Civic Stack
connector.registryDescription: 40 MCP tools for 11 Indonesian government portals - BPOM, BPJPH, AHU, OJK, BMKG+
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package indonesia-civic-stack. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the suryast account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PROXY_URL
env.description: Proxy URL for accessing Indonesian government portals from outside Indonesia (e.g. Cloudflare Worker URL)

env.name: BPS_API_KEY
env.description: BPS Statistics API key (free registration at webapi.bps.go.id)
